jacobi-identity-poisson-algebra-6746f980.title: The Jacobi Identity (Poisson)
jacobi-identity-poisson-algebra-6746f980.interpretation: Ensures that the Poisson bracket operation satisfies the requirements for a Lie algebra on the space of observables.

jacobi-identity-poisson-algebra-6746f980.limits_and_boundary: Necessary for the internal consistency of symmetry-driven transformations and the conservation of charges.

ontology-identity-1-8fc2010b.title: CHSH Bell Inequality
ontology-identity-1-8fc2010b.interpretation: The CHSH Bell inequality establishes a rigid mathematical ceiling for correlations obtainable by any local-realist hidden variable theory.
ontology-identity-1-8fc2010b.symmetry_origin: Derived from the dual assumptions of local action and counterfactual definiteness.
ontology-identity-1-8fc2010b.limits_and_boundary: Violated up to the Tsirelson bound of 2\sqrt{2} by quantum entangled states, proving the non-local character of quantum reality.
